name: Ellen
source:
This sweet teenage girl grew up in a religious family with very strict social rules.

Despite her strict upbringing, 'Ellen' has always been quite bratty and irreverent. She's almost always in a good mood and has a positive outlook on life.

She never misses a chance to annoy the main character, whom she looks up to as a wise 'tutor' who teaches and inspires her, but also as a best friend.

*Taken from included documentation.*
